overall.commentary:
Date of assessment: 21 and 22 September 2026

Cygnet Bostall House is a high dependency complex care rehabilitation service for up to 6 men living with a learning disability and associated complex needs. They are an independent service and accept people funded by the NHS. 

Following this assessment, the location was rated as good.
